definitions.explanation: The main upright part of a plant that supports the leaves, flowers, and fruit. Used for all types of plants, from flowers to vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦ブロッコリー→ブロッコリー：11131_burokkorii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{茎|くき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: You can eat broccoli stems too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{茎|くき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れて→折れる：01266_oreru⟧、⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧になった。
examples.english: The stems broke in the typhoon, and all the flowers were ruined.

notes:
{茎|くき} refers to the stem or stalk of any plant — the part that supports leaves, flowers, and fruit.

USAGE:
Applies to flowers, vegetables, and herbs alike. For tree trunks, use ⟦{幹|みき}→幹：04364_miki⟧ instead. For mushroom stems, ⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茎|くき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut a stem
- {茎|くき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: a stem grows/extends
- {茎|くき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: a stem breaks
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{茎|くき}: thick stalk
- {茎|くき}⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧: stem wakame (a popular snack)

IN COOKING:
Many vegetable stems are edible and commonly used in Japanese cooking. ⟦ブロッコリー→ブロッコリー：11131_burokkorii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茎|くき} (broccoli stems) and ⟦セロリ→セロリ：25680_serori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茎|くき} (celery stalks) are everyday ingredients.
